q: Which update supports a useful next step?
answers: Data validation is blocked by duplicate IDs. The client data owner will confirm the correction rule by 19 November.
feedback: The useful update identifies the blocker, accountable owner and confirmed date.

q: The source notes do not name an action owner. What should the update say?
answers: State that the owner is not confirmed and name the follow-up needed.
feedback: Preserve the gap and request clarification rather than inventing ownership.

q: Most tasks are complete, but an essential access test has failed. What should the update communicate?
answers: Launch is ready because most tasks are complete.
The access test blocks launch; identify the resolution owner and impact.
feedback: A critical acceptance issue must remain visible even when overall completion is high.
